{{< include pdf/modules/qc/setup.qmd >}}

```{python}
#| label: qc-reference-table
#| results: asis
from bioreport.utils.pdf_results import qc_reference_summaries
from bioreport.utils.render_output import show_print_table, typst_note
from bioreport.config import load_config
qc_reference = qc_reference_summaries(load_config())
show_print_table(qc_reference, limit=None, caption='QC Reference Ranges')
typst_note('Reference ranges are descriptive conventions, not mandatory QC rules. Final assessment requires researcher review, species and library context.')
```
